Welcome to Lumen, adventurer. I've been waiting for you.
strings.네? 저는 막 도착했을 뿐인데, 기다리고 있었다구요?: Pardon? I've only just arrived. You've been waiting for me?
strings.이쪽으로 오세요. 이리스 님을 찾아오신 분인데 이렇게 길에서 말씀드리는: Please come this way. You've come looking for Lady Iris; it would be rude to keep you talking in the street.
strings.이리스 님께서는 데미갓 프로즌 님과 오셔서 지스카드 님의 보호 아래 머물: Lady Iris arrived with Demigod Frozen and is staying under Lord Ziskad's protection.
strings.언젠가 모험가님이 오실지 모른다고 말씀하셔서 제가 미리 인상착의를 물어봤: She said you might come someday, so I asked her to describe you in advance.
Iris knows what I look like...
strings.꿈에서 모험가님을 보셨다고 해요. 너무 생생하게 말씀해주셔서 오랫동안 알: She said she saw you in her dreams. Her description was so vivid, and she said it felt as though she'd known you for a long time.
Perhaps that's why you feel familiar to me too.
strings.저기 지금 이리스는 어디에 있나요?: Um, where is Iris right now?
strings.이리스 님은 수련 중…, 이 이야기는 조금 나중으로 미룰까요?: Lady Iris is training... Shall we leave that conversation for a little later?
strings.이곳에 오자마자 해주실 일이 있어요. 정말 죄송합니다. 지금 이곳은 이리: There's something we need you to do as soon as you've arrived. I'm truly sorry. This place is under attack by demons targeting Lady Iris.
strings.쥬드 왕국의 일을 끝내고 오신지 얼마 되지 않아 모험가님께서 힘드실 수도: You must be tired after only just finishing your work in the Kingdom of Jude... but I hope you'll help us here.
strings.데이모스 교단을 상대하고 있는 와중에 럭스의 부대까지 쳐들어온 상황이라: We're already dealing with the Deimos cult, and now Lux's troops have invaded as well. We have little choice.
strings.네, 그러면 제가 도와드릴게요. 그런데 럭스의 부대가 대체 몇 군단까지: All right. I'll help. But just how many legions does Lux have? Even this is an enormous force...
The Third Legion is the one that appeared here.
strings.놀라시는 것도 무리는 아니에요. 3군단은 2군단과 함께 나타났고, 지금은: It's understandable that you're surprised. The Third Legion arrived alongside the Second, and we've confirmed that they've since moved elsewhere.
strings.계속해서 2군단과 3군단의 움직임을 파악하고 있지만, 아직 정확한 정보가: We're continuing to track the movements of the Second and Third Legions, but we don't have precise information yet.
That's everything I know and all the information we've received so far.
strings.원래 이스트랜드가 분쟁이 많은 곳지만, 마족을 상대하는 건 드문 일이에요: The East Land has always seen plenty of conflict, but fighting demons is unusual for us. Everyone is being cautious. That's why we're asking you.
I'll go out and assess the situation first.
strings.조심하세요. 마족들을 상대해서 아시겠지만, 이곳에 있는 존재는 전보다 더: Be careful. You've fought demons before, so you know, but the ones here are stronger than... Oh, already gone...
strings.대단하세요. 보통 실력이 아닐 거라 믿고 있었지만, 이렇게 금방 협곡을: Incredible. I believed you would be skilled, but I never imagined you'd return from the canyon so quickly.
You're exactly as Lady Iris described you from her dreams.
strings.(이리스의 꿈…. 언젠가 누가 이리스의 꿈에 대해 이야기했던 것 같은데: (Iris's dreams... I feel as though someone mentioned them before, but I can't quite remember...)
strings.저에게 이야기를 듣는 것보다 다른 분에게 다음 일에 대해서 이야기를 듣는: I think you should hear about your next task from someone else. Eden, who commands Lumen's main defensive force, has just returned.
strings.이든 님은 오랫동안 이곳을 지키고 계신 분이세요. 검신 지스카드 님만큼이: Eden has protected this place for a long time. He's a splendid person, just like Lord Ziskad, the Sword God.
strings.그분께서도 모험가님을 만나시고 싶어하셨어요. 어떻게 하시겠어요? 어라,: He wanted to meet you too. What do you think? Oh, is something wrong?
It's all right. Please tell me. If it's something difficult, I'll keep it secret...
strings.고마워요. 미야 님께서 그렇게 말씀해주시니…. 별 건 아니고 이제 이리스: Thank you, Miya. Hearing you say that helps... It's nothing much. I thought I'd finally reached Iris, but it's taking so long that I started to feel anxious.
strings.그런 거라면 걱정마세요. 이리스 님도 모험가 님과의 만남을 고대하고 있으: If that's all, don't worry. Lady Iris is looking forward to meeting you too.
strings.모험가님? 괜찮으세요…. 조금 피곤해 보이시는데, 회복 마법을 걸어드릴게: Adventurer? Are you all right...? You look a little tired. I'll cast a healing spell on you, so please relax.
Oh, right. Lady Iris feels sorry about this.
She doesn't need to feel so sorry...
strings.때가 되면 만나겠죠?: We'll meet when the time comes, won't we?
Yes. You certainly will. Have faith. She is the one who will become our goddess...
Miya, I feel better thanks to you. I'll go see Eden now.
strings.기다리고 있었네. 자네가 이리스 님이 말씀하셨던 그 모험가…. 듣기로는: I've been waiting. You're the adventurer Lady Iris mentioned... I've heard you've resolved many problems, from Jiendia to Freios.
strings.아, 인사부터 해야지. 그동안 복잡한 일이 생겨서 그걸 좀 해결하느라 좀: Ah, I should introduce myself first. Some complicated matters kept me busy, so I'm a little late. I'm Eden, commander of the defensive forces at the Lumen alliance headquarters.
strings.(이든이 반갑게 악수를 청하며 사람 좋은 미소를 보인다.): (Eden offers a warm handshake and a friendly smile.)
Thank you for welcoming me so warmly.
strings.원래 처음 만나는 사람은 경계해야 하는 것이 맞지. 그래도 지스카드 님께: Normally, one should be cautious around strangers. But Lord Ziskad said to welcome you openly, since you'll be helping Lady Iris.
strings.함께 다니면서 실력을 확인해보고 싶지만, 시간이 없는 만큼 바로 일을 해: I'd like to travel with you and see your skills firsthand, but we're short on time, so I'd like you to get straight to work. I know it's a lot to ask, but I trust you'll be willing.
strings.자, 그러면 폭포나무 숲으로 가게. 바로 그곳에 검후 엘 님이 계시니 그: Now, go to Waterfall Tree Forest. Sword Empress Ell is there. Help her.
strings.지스카드 님의 다섯 번째 제자로, 비록 어리지만 엄청난 검술 실력을 가지: Lord Ziskad's fifth disciple. Despite her youth, her swordsmanship is extraordinary. Even I doubted her abilities at first. Hahaha.
strings.그야말로 대단한 사람이야. 게다가 절대 수련을 게을리하지 않아. 그래서: She's truly exceptional. And she never neglects her training. I admire her for that.
strings.말씀만 들어도 대단한 사람인 것 같군요. 그런데 그곳에 혼자 계신 건가요: She sounds remarkable. But is she there alone?
strings.아무래도 직접 확인하고 싶었던 것 같아. 그래서 지스카드 님께 허락을 받: She seems to have wanted to investigate personally, so she obtained Lord Ziskad's permission.
She isn't usually like that. Perhaps something was troubling her...
strings.방금 전 말했듯이 폭포나무 숲으로 갔네. 폭포나무 숲으로 가는 길은 안: As I said, she went to Waterfall Tree Forest. The path is farther inside, so you shouldn't have trouble finding it.
We don't know what might happen, so I'll hurry.
strings.그러면 우리는 계속해서 루맨의 결계를 강화하고, 다른 적들을 찾아나서겠네: Then we'll keep strengthening Lumen's barrier and searching for other enemies.
strings.…아, 벌써 갔군. 결단력이 좋다고 해야 하나, 성격이 급하다고 해야하나: ...Oh, already gone. Should I call that decisiveness, or impatience...?
strings.일반적인 사람과는 다른 기운이 느껴져서 적인줄 알았는데, 아니군…. 넌: I sensed an aura unlike an ordinary person's and thought you were an enemy, but apparently not... Who are you?
strings.(엘이 %s의 이야기를 듣고 놀라는 표정을 짓는다.): (Ell looks surprised as she listens to %s's explanation.)
strings.이리스 님을 만나기 위해 누군가 오고 있다는 이야기는 들었다. 그런 자가: I heard someone was coming to see Lady Iris. Anyone who has traveled this far alone must have real ability...
I hope I can be of help.
strings.아니야. 분명 도움이 될 거라 생각해. 어느 정도 상황을 파악하고 있는: I'm sure you will be. You seem to understand the situation somewhat, so let's defeat the enemies here together.
strings.자, 날 따라와라. 이 협곡은 내가 손바닥 안이니까 날 따라오면 무리 없: Follow me. I know this canyon like the palm of my hand, so you'll have no trouble finding the enemy with me. Though of course, it would be better not to encounter them at all.
We're only getting started, so steel yourself.
strings.굉장해. 모험가라고 해서 그냥 평범한 사람인 줄 알았는데, 이렇게 뛰어날: Impressive. When I heard you were an adventurer, I thought you were just an ordinary person. I never expected such skill.
You really are the adventurer Lady Iris saw in her dreams...
What's on your mind? Stay focused. This is a battlefield.
strings.아직 일이 많이 남았다. 네 실력을 봤으니 그대로 믿고 다른 일을 맡기고: There's still much to do. Now that I've seen your skills, I'd like to trust you with another task. Would that be all right?
strings.그러면 폭포나무 숲에 대해서 간단하게 이야기해주지. 폭포나무 숲은 드루이: Then let me briefly explain Waterfall Tree Forest. It's an important place that retains the purity of the world's beginnings, where druids, elves, and other small communities live together.
strings.그만큼 중요한 거점이 되는 곳이지. 적들이 이곳을 점령하고 있는 상태에서: That also makes it an important strategic position. If enemy reinforcements gather here while they hold it, Lumen will be in increasing danger.
strings.그곳의 수장이 보라빛 날개를 지닌 여성 조인족. 수장을 쓰러뜨리면 될 것: Their leader is a birdwoman with violet wings. Defeating her should be enough, but there's one problem. I think you'll have an easier time facing her than I would.
strings.아쉽게도 내 검이 하늘에 있는 적에겐 닿지 않아. 아까 네 공격을 보니: Unfortunately, my sword can't reach an enemy in the sky. From what I saw earlier, that didn't stop your attacks from reaching them.
strings.그런 거라면 제가 해볼게요. 대신 엘 님이 길을 뚫어주셨으면 해요. 제가: In that case, I'll do it. But I'd like you to clear the way, Ell. This is my first time in the forest, and I might get lost.
Of course. I'll open a path so you can get inside.
You've dealt with her. I knew you would...
You certainly aren't an ordinary adventurer.
strings.덕분에 숲 안에 있던 적들이 물러나 후퇴하고 있다. 이건 모두 네 덕분…: Thanks to you, the enemies in the forest are withdrawing. This is all your doing...
strings.아니에요. 엘이 함께 해서 할 수 있었던 거에요. 그런데 무슨 일이 또: No. I could only do it because you were with me, Ell. But has something else happened?
strings.그 사이에 다른 일이 일어난 건 아니죠?: Nothing else went wrong while I was away, did it?
The enemies withdrew, but someone went after them.
strings.우리 막내 사제 울이 적들이 보석나무 숲으로 향한 걸 보고 무작정 달려간: Our youngest fellow disciple, Ull, seems to have seen them heading toward Jewel Tree Forest and rushed after them without thinking.
strings.후우, 급히 연합에 연락을 넣어 지원군을 보내달라고 하긴 했는데…. 시간: Sigh. I urgently contacted the alliance for reinforcements... but I think they'll take a while.
I've told him so often not to act alone, but he never listens. He even finds it too bothersome to ask our master's permission, as I did.
strings.울이란 사제가 간 곳이 어디죠?: Where is the place Ull went?
strings.오래 전, 탐욕스러운 고대용 글루아트가 머물던 장소야. 이름 그대로 거대: Long ago, it was home to the greedy ancient dragon Gluat. As its name suggests, it's a mysterious place where enormous trees bear all kinds of jewels...
strings.그런 곳이 다 있군요…. 그런데 왜 그렇게 불안해 하세요? 잔당을 처리하: A place like that really exists...? But why are you so worried? Didn't he just go to finish off the stragglers?
Because Lux's Second Legion is stationed there now.
Charging into the enemy's main camp alone... That's beyond reckless.
strings.스승님께서 강한 자와 싸우는 것에 집착하지 말라고 하시는데도 그러니 원…: Our master keeps telling him not to obsess over fighting strong opponents, but still... Senior Sister Yuran will scold him later too.
strings.잠깐, 분위기가 이상한데…. 저기 적들의 움직임이 달라졌다. %s, 내: Wait, something feels wrong... The enemies over there are moving differently. %s, do me a favor. I'll hold this place. You go to Ull.
strings.울이 일을 그르치지 않도록 네가 가서 먼저 손써달라는 이야기다. 물론,: I want you to get there and act before Ull makes a mess of things. Of course, he's strong too, but...
All right. Jewel Tree Forest, you said? I'll head that way.
strings.알았다. 보석나무 숲으로 가는 길은…. 벌써 갔군. 알아서 잘 찾아가겠지: Good. The path to Jewel Tree Forest is... Already gone. I'm sure you'll find it...
strings.자, 이제 너희들을 상대해주지. 날 찾아온 대가는 충분히 치뤄야 할 거야: Now, I'll deal with you. You'll pay dearly for coming after me...
Stop right there. Who are you? If you made it this far, you can't be ordinary.
I'm an adventurer who came all this way to help you...
strings.이리스 님이 말하던 그 모험가로군. 뭐, 됐어. 지금 네 도움은 필요없으: The adventurer Lady Iris mentioned. Whatever. I don't need your help right now, so go back.
strings.지금 그게 무슨 말이지? 내가 잘못 들은 건가?: What did you just say? Did I hear that wrong?
strings.네가 없이도 나 혼자로 충분하다는 이야기다. 이 앞만 봐도 보이지? 날: I'm saying I'm enough on my own. Just look ahead. So many enemies came after me, and now they lie cut down by my sword...
strings.(울이 귀찮다는 표정으로 %s의 얼굴을 빤히 바라본다.): (Ull stares at %s's face with an irritated expression.)
strings.진짜로 돌아가지 않으면 베려고 했는데, 아직도 가지 않는군. 이리스 그: I really was going to cut you down if you didn't leave, but you're still here. You and that woman Iris have something in common.
strings.너는 이런 모욕을 듣고도 자신이 해야하는 일에 대해선 절대 물러서지 않는: Even after hearing insults like these, you won't back down from what you believe you must do.
strings.함부로 이야기하지 마. 이리스는 네가 그런 말로 대해서는 안되는 사람이라: Watch your mouth. Iris isn't someone you can speak about that way.
strings.맘에 안 들어. 그렇다고 해서 이곳에서 너와 싸우지는 않겠다. 어차피 내: I don't like you. But I won't fight you here. I'd win anyway, but there's no need to do that on a battlefield.
strings.이렇게 된 김에 네 실력을 보고 싶다. 가서 적들을 상대해. 그리고 아가: Since you're here, I want to see what you can do. Go fight the enemies. And look for any trace of those Agasura.
Why should I do what you...
strings.이리스에 대한 정보를 가지고 있다고 한번만 생각했으면 넌 나를 이렇게 대: If you'd stopped to consider that I might have information about Iris, you wouldn't be treating me like this. No more excuses. Help me.
strings.마음대로 생각해. 자, 어떻게 할래?: Think what you like. Well? What will you do?
strings.어쩔 수 없군. 이 안으로 가면 되는 거야? 적을 만나면 그대로 상대해주: I don't have much choice. I go farther inside, right? And deal with any enemies I find?
strings.그래. 잘 알아듣는군. 뒤는 내가 맡을 테니 신경쓰지 말고 앞을 잘 헤쳐: Exactly. You catch on well. I'll cover the rear, so don't worry about that. Just fight your way forward.
I'll keep my eyes wide open and enjoy the show...
strings.믿을 수 없군. 내가 겨우 인간에게 이렇게 무너지다니. 변명은 하지 않겠: I can't believe it. To fall like this to a mere human... I won't make excuses. Kill me, human. Ending it here is best for everyone. So...
I'd like to hear what you have to say...
strings.럭스는 마계에서도 적이 많은데, 그 안을 해결하지도 않고 밖으로 나온 이: Lux has plenty of enemies in the demon realm. Why did he come out here before dealing with them?
strings.단지, 이 세계의 주인이 되기 위해서 신이 될 소녀를 노리는 거야? 군단: Is he targeting the girl who will become a goddess simply to rule this world? I'm asking because you're a legion commander. Don't you know anything? Well...
strings.모르는 거야? 아니면 대답을 하고 싶지 않은 거야? 어쩔 수 없지. 그러: Don't you know, or don't you want to answer? Fine. Then I'll have to end this...
Stand back, %s. Leave the rest to me.
You're the one who fought me before... Ull, was it...
strings.(나는, 나는 왜 그때 그랬던 거지….): (Why... why did I act like that...?)
strings.(일단 뒤로 물러나서 쉬어. 아가슈라에 대해선 조용히 하고.): (Step back and rest for now. Keep quiet about the Agasura.)
Hey, white cat. I know all about your situation. Listen to me.
strings.수인이었던 너희들이 스스로 마계에 들어간 것은 뭐 그렇다 쳐. 넌 네가: I'll set aside why beastfolk like you willingly entered the demon realm. You had no choice but to serve Lux to save your White Lion clan. But was it a good choice?
strings.여기저기서 고통받던 너희들이 선택할 수 길은 고작 그런 것뿐이겠지만 말이: After suffering wherever you went, I suppose that was the only path left to you.
If you die here, your whole clan is finished too, right? Answer me...
strings.좋아. 군단 내에 비슷한 경우가 여럿있다고 들었다. 그러니 제안을 할테니: Good. I've heard there are several groups in a similar position within the legions. I'll make you an offer, and you'll accept it.
I have a separate job for you, and I want you to do it...
strings.저번에 나와 싸우면서 내가 물러난 게 궁금하지 않아? 내가 네 실력을 좀: Aren't you curious why I withdrew when we fought last time? I wanted to test your abilities.
strings.너를 비롯한 백사자 일족. 의외로 너희는 쓸 곳이 많아서 생각해봤지. 특: You and the White Lion clan have more uses than I expected, so I gave it some thought. I especially want to make use of you.
strings.마계에서 럭스를 비롯해 부하에게 존경을 받고 있는 너, 첩자일에 딱 좋을: You're respected in the demon realm by Lux and by the troops under you. You'd make an ideal spy.
So I've decided. I'll use you, and in return, I'll take responsibility for sheltering your clan.
All you have to do is choose.
strings.지금 무슨 소리를 하는 거지? 내가 왜?!: What are you talking about? Why should I?!
strings.다시 한 번 이 땅에서 살 기회를 주는 거다. 한번 더 설명해주지. 네가: I'm giving you a chance to live on this land again. Let me explain once more. Even if you sacrifice yourself, your clan can dream of a future here again.
strings.울, 대체 무슨 소리를 하는 거지?: Ull, what on earth are you talking about?
Stay out of it. This is between me and the cat.
strings.마계에서 무의미하게 죽어가는 것보다는 이곳에서 조금이라도 앞을 보는 미래: Wouldn't a future with even a little hope here be better than dying pointlessly in the demon realm?
strings.덕분에 도움이 됐다. 나머지는 내가 알아서 할테니 돌아가서 이든 아저씨에: You've been helpful. I'll handle the rest. Go back and tell old man Eden that everyone withdrew along with Legion Commander Veska.
strings.대체 무슨 짓을 꾸미고 있는 거야?: What on earth are you planning?
strings.재미있는 짓을 해보려고. 할지 말지는 아직 몰라. 일단 계획만 세우고 있: Something interesting. I don't know whether I'll actually do it yet. I'm only making plans for now. Don't tell anyone.
I'll try not to concern myself with that. But...
strings.아가슈라에 대해선 이야기를 왜 하지 말라고 했던 거야?: Why did you tell me not to mention the Agasura?
strings.네가 알지 모르겠지만, 붉은 머리 두 사람이 이 근처에서 우리를 구경하고: You may not have noticed, but two red-haired people were watching us nearby. They seemed to be planning to spy on us and slip away...
strings.마족들이 움직이자마자 바로 도망갔다. 녀석들이 맞지? 모스 왕국와 손잡: They ran off as soon as the demons moved. They're the ones, right? The ones who allied with the Kingdom of Moss...
Yes. The ones who used magic stones to brainwash the smaller tribes and make them attack the Kingdom of Jude...
Right, so that's it. That explains the strange things they had tagging along.
strings.잘은 모르겠지만, 인공적인 존재 같았다. 일반적인 마족과도 다르고, 몬스: I'm not sure, but they seemed artificial. Different from ordinary demons, and different from monsters too...
strings.그런데 이 재미가 계속 유지되려면 그 놈들이 빨리 나타나야 하는데 숨어버: But for things to stay interesting, those two need to show up again soon. They've gone into hiding, and that's no fun.
strings.(지스카드 님이 어떤 분인지 잘 모르겠지만, 울을 왜 제자로 삼은 거지?: (I don't know much about Lord Ziskad, but why did he take Ull as a disciple?)
strings.(이야기만 들으면 세상 훌륭하신 분인데….): (From everything I've heard, he's supposed to be an extraordinary person...)
strings.무슨 생각을 그렇게 해? 일단 이걸로 녀석들이 잠입하는 것도 막았고, 마: What are you thinking so hard about? We've stopped their infiltration and repelled the demon attack. Is there something else wrong?
I wounded them badly too, so they won't show up for a while.
All right. I'll go back and report. Leaving out what you did.
strings.잘 생각했다. 아스마라는 마법사에게 네 이야길 했으니 이든 아저씨에게 갔: Good choice. I've told a mage named Asma about you. Go see her after you visit old man Eden. She'll open the path to the alliance headquarters.
No need to look so surprised. I'm only doing what my master told me. And unless you intend to fight me and win right now, get going...
Sigh. Left without even hearing me out. Still, that power...
strings.(보고를 받은 이든의 표정이 한결 가벼워 보인다.): (After hearing the report, Eden looks noticeably relieved.)
strings.오래 걸릴 거라고 생각했는데, 생각보다 일찍 끝나서 다행이군. 검신의 제: I thought this would take a long time, so I'm glad it ended sooner than expected. That's thanks to you and the Sword God's disciples. Thank you.
strings.검신의 제자들을 본 소감이 어떤가? 역시 보통 사람들이 아니지?: What did you think of the Sword God's disciples? Hardly ordinary people, are they?
strings.그래서 이스트랜드에서 다른 세력들보다 루맨에 있는 빛의 연합이 미래가 밝: That's why people say the Alliance of Light in Lumen has a brighter future than the other powers in the East Land.
strings.다시 한 번 방어군을 대표해. 고생 많았다는 말을 전하네. 지스카드 님께: Once again, on behalf of the defensive forces, thank you for your hard work. Lord Ziskad has given you permission to enter the area containing the alliance headquarters.
Of course. However, letting you inside isn't something I can do. A powerful magical barrier surrounds the headquarters, and only authorized people may enter.
strings.그러기 위해선 아스마 님에게 가야 하네. 저기 저쪽에 보석과 함께 있는: For that, you'll need to see Asma. Do you see the mage over there with the jewels?
strings.지스카드 님의 허락이 있기 전부터 울이 미리 부탁을 한 모양이더군. 자네: Apparently, Ull asked her in advance, even before Lord Ziskad gave permission. He told her to open the barrier and let you through as soon as she saw you. Hehe. Off you go, then.
All right, I'll be going. See you later.
strings.(그나저나 울이 그랬단 말이지…. 의왼데….): (So Ull did that... I wasn't expecting it...)
strings.아, 왔다갔다 하면서 봤는데, 바로 %s 님? 전 아스마에요. 편하게 아: Oh, I've seen you going back and forth. You're %s, right? I'm Asma. Please, just call me Asma.
strings.이리스 님께서 말씀하신 분 맞죠? 이든 님, 지스카드 님, 그리고 울 부: You're the person Lady Iris mentioned, right? Eden, Lord Ziskad, and Ull all asked about you, so I've been waiting. I'll open the barrier for you.
Thank you, Lady Asma... No, Asma...
strings.(드디어 루맨에 왔어. 부디 이 여정이 여기서 끝이길….): (I've finally reached Lumen. Please let this journey end here...)
strings.인증되셨어요. 이제 결계 안으로 들어갈 수 있어요, %s 님!: You're authorized now. You can enter the barrier, %s!
